plan.folds: Each of all seven stations excluded from the entire training set; train other six on 10:00-10:29:30, test excluded station at 10:30-11:00 GPST. No test-half rows of any station enter training.
plan.support: Retain whole-block unseen-support and rowspace failures from frozen predict_block. Whole-cohort RMS is null if any test row unsupported; report supported RMS with its matching zero baseline.
plan.comparison: Two within-product spatial-transfer experiments, rapid and final, on identical fixed paths. Pooled summaries concatenate disjoint held-out test stations, not independent trials. No model selection using test scores.
plan.stopping_rule: Evaluate all seven folds on both frozen reports once; retain all failures, no replacement stations, windows, retraining on held-out stations or new acquisition.
plan.scope: Exploratory conditional receiver transfer on exposed reference-only clock-free contrasts; upstream CODE products may include held-out receivers. Not absolute RF, independent confirmation, target positioning or covariance qualification.

interpretation: Pooled folds share training observations and are not independent trials; only local correction training excludes each receiver.
